lines.beaver_en: I'm contacting you for a local industry survey.
lines.learner: 네, 반갑습니다. 저는 시장에서 자영업을 해요.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. I run my own business at the market.
lines.roman: Ne, bangapseumnida. Jeoneun sijangeseo jayeongeobeul haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What is this region's main industry?
lines.learner: 어업이 제일 커요. 어업 외에 농업도 중요해요.
lines.en: Fishing is the biggest. Besides fishing, farming matters too.
lines.roman: Eoeobi jeil keoyo. Eoeop oee nongeopdo jungyohaeyo.

lines.learner: 가을에 추수가 끝나면 햇곡식이 많이 나와요.
lines.en: After the autumn harvest, lots of new grain comes out.
lines.roman: Gaeure chusuga kkeunnamyeon haetgoksigi mani nawayo.

lines.beaver_en: How large is the production volume?
lines.learner: 올해 수확은 좋았어요. 축산물 생산량도 늘었어요.
lines.en: This year's harvest was good. Livestock output grew too.
lines.roman: Olhae suhwageun joasseoyo. Chuksanmul saengsallyangdo neureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you sell farm and marine products?
lines.en: We ship them to Seoul through brokers.

lines.beaver_en: Are there any problems with transportation?
lines.en: There are few shipping companies, so it's a bit inconvenient.

lines.beaver: 산업과 기업에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about industry and businesses?
lines.beaver_roman: Saneopgwa gieobe daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 예전에는 석탄을 캤는데, 지금은 제조 공장이 있어요.
lines.en: We used to mine coal, but now there are factories.
lines.roman: Yejeoneneun seoktaneul kaenneunde, jigeumeun jejo gongjangi isseoyo.

lines.learner: 젊은 노동력이 공장으로 가서 어업이 힘들어요.
lines.en: Young workers go to factories, so fishing is struggling.
lines.roman: Jeolmeun nodongnyeogi gongjangeuro gaseo eoeobi himdeureoyo.

lines.learner: 큰 회사 지사가 생기면 서비스업도 커질 거예요.
lines.en: If big company branches open, services will grow too.
lines.roman: Keun hoesa jisaga saenggimyeon seobiseueopdo keojil geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 말씀 감사합니다. 정책에 잘 반영하겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you. I'll reflect this in our policies.
lines.beaver_roman: Joeun malsseum gamsahamnida. Jeongchaege jal banyeonghagetseumnida.
lines.en: Please keep caring about our region. Thank you.
